reference_crop.note: The 1920x810 upload carries a pillarboxed 16:9 picture; one fixed crop box is used for every reference frame.

robustness_rule.description: A metric is robust when the sign of the delta is the same and min|delta| >= 0.4 * max|delta| across the game-only comparisons; sensitivity_ref_all is reported but excluded from the verdict.

metric_definitions.luma_mean: Mean Rec.709 luma Y=0.2126R+0.7152G+0.0722B of the sRGB-encoded values in [0,1].
metric_definitions.luma_std: Population standard deviation of luma over all pixels.
metric_definitions.frac_near_white_upper75: UI-exclusion sensitivity metric: same as frac_near_white but on rows 0-75% only. Burned-in tutorial subtitles live in rows > 80%, so this value cannot contain subtitle pixels.
metric_definitions.frac_deep_shadow_upper75: UI-exclusion sensitivity metric: same as frac_deep_shadow but on rows 0-75% only.
metric_definitions.sat_mean: Mean HSV saturation S (HSV computed on sRGB-encoded RGB, H in degrees).
metric_definitions.colorfulness: Hasler-Suesstrunk colorfulness on 8-bit sRGB: M = sqrt(std_rg^2+std_yb^2) + 0.3*sqrt(mean_rg^2+mean_yb^2), rg=R-G, yb=0.5(R+G)-B.
metric_definitions.local_contrast_mean: Mean over non-overlapping 16x16 blocks of the population standard deviation of luma inside the block (blocks that fit; remainder cropped).
metric_definitions.edge_energy: Mean Sobel gradient magnitude of luma, normalised by 4*sqrt(2) (max possible Sobel response on [0,1] luma) and clipped to [0,1]; 3x3 Sobel kernels, image border excluded.
metric_definitions.contrast_top_third: local_contrast_mean restricted to the top third of rows.
metric_definitions.contrast_bottom_third: local_contrast_mean restricted to the bottom third of rows.
metric_definitions.sky_mean_r/g/b: Mean sRGB channel value over the top 40% of rows.
metric_definitions.sky_luma_mean: Mean luma over the top 40% of rows.
metric_definitions.sky_luma_std: Population standard deviation of luma over the top 40% of rows.
metric_definitions.sky_sat_mean: Mean HSV saturation over the top 40% of rows.
metric_definitions.sky_blue_frac: Fraction of top-40% pixels with HSV hue in [190,250] deg and saturation > 0.35.
metric_definitions.splittone_bright_rb: Mean (R-B) in 8-bit levels (x255) over pixels with luma >= per-image p80.
metric_definitions.splittone_dark_rb: Mean (R-B) in 8-bit levels (x255) over pixels with luma <= per-image p20.
metric_definitions.red_accent_frac: Fraction of pixels with HSV hue in [335,360) U [0,25] deg, saturation > 0.45 and value > 0.15.
metric_definitions.rgb_mean_r/g/b: Mean sRGB channel value over all pixels.
metric_definitions.gb_mean: Mean (G-B) over all pixels, 8-bit levels (teal/cyan-cast signal).

set_definitions.reference_primary: Reference frames classed gameplay_outdoor (clean platforming, outdoors).
set_definitions.reference_interior: Reference frames classed gameplay_interior (no current-build interior shot exists).
set_definitions.reference_combat_tutorial: Reference frames classed combat_tutorial (flagged, not platforming).
set_definitions.reference_gameplay_extended: All gameplay reference frames (outdoor + interior + combat tutorial).
set_definitions.reference_all: All 24 extracted reference frames, including cutscenes and the loading screen.
set_definitions.current_old_per_image: Previous capture pass (artifacts/*.png + artifacts/review/*.png), gameplay only, per-image weighting. Contains many near-duplicate tuning variants of one scene.
set_definitions.current_old_scene: Same previous-pass images, but aggregated per near-duplicate scene cluster (one equal-weight sample per scene), threshold CLUSTER_MAE on 64x36 luma thumbs.
set_definitions.current_all: Fresh + previous gameplay shots (fresh + old per-image).
